rows.text: Riya asked Hannah Cho whether her son Jun wants the same Riverdale Farm camp weeks (Jul 13-24) so they could split drop-offs. Hannah's number is +1 416-555-0163; Jun is Leo's close friend.

The old pricing page lumenpay.example.com/pricing-legacy moved to lumenpay.example.com/pricing. Riya still needs to fix 5 links in: Instant Payouts PRD (Overview, Appendix B), Beta merchant FAQ, Onboarding 2.0 retro, Sales one-pager draft, before beta materials go out.

Running with Marcus Bell: Sundays 07:30 (since 2026-04-19, moved from Saturdays because Leo has Saturday morning soccer); meet at the foot of Leslie Street for the Tommy Thompson Park out-and-back.

Leo plays in the Leslieville house league soccer (U8), Saturdays 9:00-10:00 at Jimmie Simpson Park field 2 (arrive 8:45), April to June and September to October. 2026 spring season: 2026-04-18 to 2026-06-20, no game Sat 2026-05-16, picture day Sat 2026-05-30. Saturday mornings are therefore busy.

Documents are in Drive /Household/Car/Insurance.

Grace (relative in Ottawa) wants to send Leo a just-because parcel; Riya will ask Leo what he is into. The assistant has no note of Leo's current interests; suggest nut-free items.
Riya wants a dental cleaning with Dr. Lin at Danforth Smiles on Wed 2026-04-22, late morning; slots offered 11:00 or 11:40 (60 min, about 15 min from home); not yet booked as of 2026-04-19.

Biscuit's regular vet, Dr. Moreau's clinic, is weekdays only. Decision (2026-04-19, PRD decision log, PAY-1417): payout webhook retries use exponential backoff with a 72-hour retry window (Aisha Rahman's proposal), chosen over a fixed 24-hour window. Owner: Riya Malhotra.

Riya's Toronto Public Library card ends in 4417; her home branch is Pape/Danforth.

Biscuit has a vet appointment Tue 2026-04-28 18:00-18:30 with Dr. Kaur at Riverside Veterinary Clinic: wellness exam, DHPP and rabies boosters, about $214.50 before tax. Records transfer from the old clinic was requested; bring any paper vaccine record.

Riya's home address is 41 Curzon St, Toronto ON M4M 3B5 (Leslieville, semi-detached house). The household has a Mazda and a basement.

Open decisions: wall behind range and sink, 2 or 3 pendant lights over island, cabinet hardware brushed brass vs matte black; under-cabinet lighting is decided as warm white.

Riya's Visa (card ending 8820) statement: balance $2,184.33, due Thu 2026-05-14. Autopay pays the full balance from the TD joint chequing account; the joint balance covers it with about $3,940 to spare.
Pape Rec Centre summer program registration opens Mon 2026-04-27 at 07:00 (Riya wanted a reminder).

Riya's in-laws (Sam's parents) are visiting Toronto May 16-18, 2026. Riya blocked time on 2026-04-24 09:00 to plan: needs something to do on Saturday (May 16) and where to eat; the agent was to prepare Saturday options.

Riya has 'Buy printer ink (HP 67)' on her To-do. Prices checked 2026-04-23: best is Best Buy HP 67XL black $47.99 (sale until Sun 2026-04-26); Staples 67XL black $49.99, 67XL tri-colour $54.99; Canadian Tire combo pack $59.99. 67XL black is on the Hardware store list.

Home internet has been unstable since 2026-04-24 (repeated WAN drops, ~6% packet loss, ONT 'optical signal low' and loss-of-signal errors, pointing to the provider's line, not the router). Riya's internet provider is not known or linked to the agent, so no support ticket has been opened; evidence is saved in Notes as 'internet drops 2026-04-24'.

Plan: two #10 x 3 in screws into a stud, or two 1/4 in snap toggles / a 60 cm French cleat; tape the spot first. Shopping list at Home Hardware (Queen St E): snap toggles 4-pack $9.49, French cleat kit $24.99, painter's tape $6.99.

Riya and family plan to drive to Sam's parents' place on Fri 2026-05-01, leaving right after school pickup (Riya's pickup is 15:15-15:30; she can leave around 15:45). She wanted a live traffic estimate on the day.
Morse Street PS spring photo day is Wed 2026-04-29 (no hats); order forms go home Monday, online orders close Fri 2026-05-08, retakes Thu 2026-05-21.

Pai Northern Thai Kitchen (Duncan St) is a delivery option the family uses. Riya must tell Nate (Northline Renovations) by Mon 2026-04-27 what she wants on the wall behind the range and sink; he needs it to order with a 3-week lead time. Nothing from her earlier inspiration browsing is saved; he accepts a picture or product link.

Riya volunteered (reply sent 2026-04-25 to Jenna Wu, neighbourhood association) for the 2-4pm lemonade and snack table at the Curzon/Bertmount street party on Sat 2026-06-13; she cannot do setup (9-11am).
Leslieville Farmers' Market opens Sun 2026-05-10 and runs Sundays 9am-2pm at Jonathan Ashbridge Park, 1490 Queen St E, through late October. Riya did not want it added to the calendar.

Evening options nearby: Riverdale Farm 'Spring Lambs' until 19:00 (free), Pape/Danforth library family Lego club 18:00-19:00 (registration required).

Riya often reads on her phone between things and asked for shorter replies ('shorter pls'); keep replies short, especially when she is out of the house or at the office.

Riya is out of office Fri 2026-05-22 and back Mon 2026-05-25; Aisha Rahman covers payouts questions. OOO email drafted but not yet turned on; the Fri 22 May standup and lunch & learn need declining and the Fernwood Coffee check-in was moved off that day.

Recorded in the Notion 'Instant Payouts PRD' decision log; Linear PAY-1390 (Jonah) was still in Sprint 21 scope and may need moving to the v1.1 backlog.

Earlier Instant Payouts decisions: 2026-04-09 retry payout webhooks with exponential backoff over a 72 h window (Aisha's proposal, fewer missed events than fixed 24 h); 2026-04-22 beta capped at 40 merchants for support load (Riya).

Riya records product decisions in the Decision log of the Notion 'Instant Payouts PRD' as a table row (Date, Decision, Why, Owner) with the date of the decision, and Aisha watches that page; after logging a decision, offer a heads-up in #payouts-launch.

Standing rule from 2026-05-19: the assistant may send routine scheduling replies directly (accepting, proposing or confirming times) without showing Riya first. Any other email still needs Riya to approve the draft before sending. Saved in notes as 'Email rules'.

GA readiness review for Instant Payouts is Wed 10 Jun 2026, 10:00-10:25 (set by Aisha Rahman); GA readiness checklist ticket is PAY-1185.

Instant Payouts beta feedback log: saved in notes as 'Beta feedback log: structure'. Columns: date, merchant, source, quote/summary, theme (speed, notifications, cutoff times, webhooks, copy, other), severity (blocker/annoying/nice-to-have), owner, status, link.
